01-read-intent.evidence: Read app mode, project context, architecture design, current src scaffold, scripts absence, plans, tests, and logs

02-create-plan.evidence: Refreshed plans for scaffold-vs-design review including missing scripts scaffold

03-update-design.evidence: Updated design/architecture.md with scripts scaffold alignment and scripts boundaries

04-update-tests.evidence: Added tests/unit/test_scripts_scaffold.py for scripts scaffold validator

06-run-validation.evidence: Scaffold validator, unit tests, py_compile, diff check, and Codex contract validation passed

07-fix-failures.evidence: Fixed scripts test import by adding scripts/__init__.py and requiring it in scaffold validator

08-update-logs.evidence: Logged DEV-015 design, code, test, and validation results

09-detect-gaps.evidence: No new evidence-backed gaps remain after scripts scaffold alignment

10-iteration-review.evidence: Iteration complete; scaffold and scripts aligned with design; no new src component families added
